input.summary: Feed the upper-right flipper from the left orbit for two Turbo locks, start 3x playfield scoring before Turbo Multiball when ready, then collect ramp Jackpots and park balls only when relocking improves value and control.

quickInfo.name: Turbo Multiball
quickInfo.summary: The left orbit lights the upper Turbo lock, and two locks start three-ball play with both ramps lit for Jackpots.

quickInfo.name: Turbo relock
quickInfo.summary: Parking a ball in Turbo raises the current ramp Jackpot, while locking all balls awards the first Super Jackpot.

quickInfo.name: 3x Playfield
quickInfo.summary: A 30-second playfield multiplier that triples normal scoring, multiball Jackpots, and earned laps.

quickInfo.name: Turbo Boost
quickInfo.summary: A two-ball Speedway mode where the left ramp raises its decaying Jackpot and Turbo collects it.

quickInfo.name: Victory Lap
quickInfo.summary: Reach Position 1, 200 laps, Light-Up wave 6, or Checkered Flag after all ten Speedways to light the 500M shot.

steps.text: Make the left-ramp skill shot after launch. Then shoot the left orbit to light the first Turbo lock.
Use the upper-right flipper to shoot Turbo. Repeat the left-orbit and upper-Turbo sequence for the second lock.
When 3x Playfield is ready and safe to start, activate it immediately before the multiball conversion.
During Turbo Multiball, collect the two initially lit ramp Jackpots. Continue at the alternating lit ramp.
modeNotes: Turbo Multiball: Two upper locks start three-ball play. Both ramps light first, then the Jackpot alternates.
Turbo relock: Each parked ball adds to the current Jackpot. Locking all three awards the first Super Jackpot and later introduces a fourth ball for another cycle.

steps.text: Park one or two balls in Turbo when it improves control and Jackpot value. Do not surrender all balls automatically for the one-time Super.
Use active Speedways and 3x Playfield during multiball when their start does not cost the main lock route.

fallback.title: Turbo Boost control
fallback.when: Use this when the upper Turbo lock is unreliable but its Speedway is available.

steps.text: Start Turbo Boost Speedway.
Cradle one ball. Shoot the left ramp to raise the decaying Turbo Jackpot.
Shoot Turbo to collect. Repeat only while ball control remains stable.
Return to Fast Laps and position progress after one ball remains.

alternatives.title: Pit Stop Multiball
alternatives.when: Use this when PIT lanes and the right ramp progress naturally.

steps.text: Complete PIT and shoot the right ramp to park a ball.
Return to the right ramp before the Pit Stop timer expires. A faster stop lights more Car Shot Jackpots.
Collect the lit Car Shot Jackpots under two-ball protection.
Reach Position 1, earn 200 laps, finish Light-Up wave 6, or play all ten Speedways and start Checkered Flag.
Start Victory Lap at the center hole.
Stack it with a safe multiball or 3x Playfield only when the installed ROM permits the overlap.
Repeat Turbo Multiballs for escalating ramp Jackpot and Super Jackpot cycles.

playfieldReferences.label: Turbo lock light
playfieldReferences.description: Outer-left loop that lights Turbo locks and feeds the upper-right flipper.

playfieldReferences.label: Turbo lock
playfieldReferences.description: Upper lock shot made from the upper-right flipper and used for multiball relocks.

playfieldReferences.label: Yellow Car ramp
playfieldReferences.description: Skill-shot and Jackpot ramp that also builds Turbo Boost value.

playfieldReferences.label: Speed ramp
playfieldReferences.description: Blue Car ramp used for Jackpots, Fast Laps, and Pit Stop.

playfieldReferences.label: Center hole
playfieldReferences.description: Saucer used for Green Flag awards, Speedway starts, Extra Ball, and Victory Lap.

playfieldReferences.label: P-I-T rollovers
playfieldReferences.description: Three upper lanes that qualify Pit Stop Multiball and later raise Bonus X.

techniques.name: Upper-flipper Turbo lock
techniques.instruction: Use the left orbit to feed the upper-right flipper. Shoot the lit Turbo lock on the fly.

techniques.name: Turbo ball park
techniques.instruction: Park one or two balls in Turbo to simplify control while the remaining ball attacks a lit ramp.

cautions.issue: Turbo ejects toward the right inlane and can jump the wireform or cross the flippers.
cautions.response: Keep both flippers ready and separate the returned ball before you aim another shot.

cautions.issue: Rejected left-ramp shots can return toward the center, and the game has no kickback.
cautions.response: Use the ramp only from a controlled angle. Do not depend on an outlane recovery.

cautions.issue: The center-hole and pop feed enters the PIT lanes and bumpers.
cautions.response: Nudge early through the bumper exit. Be ready for either lower-flipper return.

Test left orbit, upper Turbo lock and eject, both ramps, center hole, PIT lanes, pop exit, right orbit, and every return feed.
input.simpleOverview: Indianapolis 500 uses the left orbit to feed two Turbo locks and start a three-ball ramp-Jackpot Multiball. Prepare 3x Playfield first when possible, start Turbo Multiball, and park a ball only when the higher Jackpot and extra control justify reducing active balls.
input.overview: Indianapolis 500 uses the left orbit to feed two Turbo locks and start a three-ball ramp-Jackpot Multiball. Start the 30-second 3x Playfield before Multiball when ready, then collect ramp Jackpots under the multiplier. Relock selectively for control or the Super Jackpot rather than parking every ball automatically.
